At no point has any director, staff member, or volunteer of Homeless Project Scotland physically assaulted a service user, nor have we ever instructed or permitted anyone to do so. Such behaviour would be entirely contrary to our safeguarding policies, training, and values, and would result in immediate action.

We operate under strict safeguarding procedures, with trained volunteers, incident reporting systems, and CCTV in place. Any allegation of this seriousness would be formally recorded, investigated, and where appropriate reported to the relevant authorities. To date, no such incident matching this description has been reported, witnessed by independent parties, or substantiated.

We welcome genuine concerns raised in good faith and encourage anyone with specific information to contact us directly so it can be properly examined. However, making serious allegations without evidence is misleading and damaging, particularly to a volunteer-led organisation supporting vulnerable people during a homelessness crisis.
